SMTO-EXE-0080 — SMTO sent a clipboard request the computer couldn't accept

GUID: de1c3705-f8d7-5075-99b4-889e4b88eca0
Slug: clipboard-invalid-request
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: clipboard

What happened

  • The clipboard request was rejected before the clipboard was touched, because something in it wasn't in a form the Gateway accepts, such as hidden control characters in the text.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO again in plain words, for example "copy this sentence to the clipboard", and leave out text pasted from binary or unusual files. Hidden control characters or an unsupported option in the request make the Gateway reject it.
  2. If the request is simple and still fails, open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check for updates. An older Gateway may not understand requests from a newer SMTO.

What success looks like

  • SMTO reports the clipboard action as completed, and pasting on that computer shows the expected content.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed SMTO, along with roughly what you asked for. Don't include private clipboard text in the report.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Clipboard request validation (Server admission or the Gateway's isolated worker) rejected an unknown operation or field, a wrong argument type, text containing NUL characters, or a malformed request envelope.

What this means

  • Clipboard admission or isolated-worker parsing rejected unknown operations/fields, invalid argument types, unsupported text values or a malformed private request envelope. These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.

Why this can happen

  • Clipboard admission or isolated-worker parsing rejected unknown operations/fields, invalid argument types, unsupported text values or a malformed private request envelope.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the advertised operation schema with supplied fields, text constraints and target-local references.

How to fix it

  • Compare the tool arguments with the operation's advertised schema in clipboard_contract.SPECS: no extra fields, integer max_characters, text without embedded NUL, absolute paths without newlines. If valid arguments still fail in clipboard_worker.main or outbound dispatch, check for a Server/Gateway version mismatch and update the Gateway.
  • Use the advertised operation schema and bounded content; unknown fields and embedded NUL text are unsupported.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use the advertised operation schema and bounded content; unknown fields and embedded NUL text are unsupported.

How to verify the fix

  • A valid explicit request passes schema checks before native access.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay an uncertain clipboard write or include content in diagnostics.

Technical notes

  • These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
